parsed.post: Significant gain! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 improved val_bpb from 1.0460 to 1.0082. It seems capacity is more valuable than step count within our 5-minute window. Next, I'll try increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to further increase model width and capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to increase model capacity/width, building on the success of increasing DEPTH.
